description: Back-facing athletic sprint CONTACT pose. Lean torso forward, left knee high, right leg extends behind. Empty left arm drives backward outside waist, opposite leg. Right hand holds katana low beside right hip, blade trailing. Hands separated; only ONE free arm swings. Preserve exact head/hair/outfit and size. Strong bent running knees and push-off, not walking or waving arms together. Keep back view, centered 80x80, feet at y72, transparent background.
